69232-slave-of-eternity.title: Slave Of Eternity
69232-slave-of-eternity.creator: Unknown
69232-slave-of-eternity.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. They sank through the ordered vastness of Nyark the first city, into a bustle and rush that was symbolic of the Council's will to restore Nyark--and finally Earth--to their former glory. Heric was led to a quiet chamber where the Council, in their deep crescent of seats behind the Leader's throne, awaited him.

arxiv-2109-12712.title: Vronicle: A System for Producing Videos with Verifiable Provenance
arxiv-2109-12712.creator: Yuxin (Myles) Liu, Yoshimichi Nakatsuka, Ardalan Amiri Sani, Sharad Agarwal, Gene Tsudik
arxiv-2109-12712.description: Abstract Demonstrating the veracity of videos is a longstanding problem that has recently become more urgent and acute. It is extremely hard to accurately detect manipulated videos using content analysis, especially in the face of subtle, yet effective, manipulations, such as frame rate changes or skin tone adjustments.

arxiv-2207-09069.title: Correcting for Measurement Error in Segmented Cox Model
arxiv-2207-09069.creator: Sarit Agami
arxiv-2207-09069.description: Abstract Measurement error in the covariate of main interest (e.g. the exposure variable, or the risk factor) is common in epidemiologic and health studies. It can effect the relative risk estimator or other types of coefficients derived from the fitted regression model. In order to perform a measurement error analysis, one needs information about the error structure.

arxiv-2302-13130.title: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
arxiv-2302-13130.creator: Tarasha Khurana, Peiyun HuDavid HeldDeva RamananCarnegie Mellon University
arxiv-2302-13130.description: Abstract Predicting how the world can evolve in the future is crucial for motion planning in autonomous systems. Classical methods are limited because they rely on costly human annotations in the form of semantic class labels, bounding boxes, and tracks or HD maps of cities to plan their motion — and thus are difficult to scale to large unlabeled datasets.

arxiv-2408-16558.title: Circuit QED Spectra in the Ultrastrong Coupling Regime: How They Differ from Cavity QED
arxiv-2408-16558.creator: Samuel Napoli, Alberto Mercurio, Daniele Lamberto, Andrea Zappalà, Omar Di Stefano, Salvatore Savasta
arxiv-2408-16558.description: Abstract Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) studies the interaction between resonator-confined radiation and natural atoms or other formally equivalent quantum excitations, under conditions where the quantum nature of photons is relevant. Phenomena studied in cavity QED can also be explored using superconducting artificial atoms and microwave photons in superconducting resonators.

arxiv-2506-04499.title: FALO: F ast and A ccurate L iDAR 3D O bject Detection on Resource-Constrained Devices
arxiv-2506-04499.creator: Shizhong Han Hsin-Pai Cheng Hong Cai Jihad Masri Soyeb Nagori Fatih Porikli
arxiv-2506-04499.description: Abstract Existing LiDAR 3D object detection methods predominantly rely on sparse convolutions and/or transformers, which can be challenging to run on resource-constrained edge devices, due to irregular memory access patterns and high computational costs. In this paper, we propose FALO, a hardware-friendly approach to LiDAR 3D detection, which offers both state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection accuracy and fast inference speed.

pmc-10673711.title: Translation of tissue-based artificial intelligence into clinical practice: from discovery to adoption
pmc-10673711.creator: Alice Geaney, Paul O’Reilly, Perry Maxwell, Jacqueline A. James, Darragh McArt, Manuel Salto-Tellez
pmc-10673711.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Digital pathology (DP), or the digitization of pathology images, has transformed oncology research and cancer diagnostics. The application of artificial intelligence (AI) and other forms of machine learning (ML) to these images allows for better interpretation of morphology, improved quantitation of biomarkers, introduction of novel concepts to discovery and diagnostics (such as spatial distribution of cellular elements), and the promise of a new paradigm of cancer biomarkers.

pmc-12452530.title: The Safety and Performance of a Novel Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation Device in a Long-Term Ovine Model
pmc-12452530.creator: Yongchao Li, Lei Cai, Jia Huang, Hongbin Gao, Zhongqiang Huang, Yalun Guan, Yunfeng Li, Shuhua Liu, Shi Liang, Summer Xiatian Li, Hongzhou Lu, Ge Li, Yijiang Li, Yu Zhang, Sebastian Majewski
pmc-12452530.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights What are the main findings? In this work, we evaluated a novel extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) device (Lifemotion®, Chinabridge, China) with veno-nenous (VV) and veno-arterial (VA) ECMO in a ovine model for assessing the safety and performance of the ECMO device and found the ECMO device could support in keeping experimental sheep alive for 14 days and showed a comparable performance as the marketed product (Novalung® Xlung™ kit 230, Xonis, Germany). What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12733831.title: Newborn Screening in Fabry Disease
pmc-12733831.creator: Marta Olszewska, Krzysztof Schwermer, Krzysztof Pawlaczyk
pmc-12733831.description: Fabry disease (FD) is an X-linked genetic disease caused by deficient α galactosidase A activity, leading to a lysosomal storage disorder of globotriaosylceramide, causing organ damages. There are two most common clinical manifestations of the disease: classic FD with a typical onset of symptoms in childhood in males, and later-onset variants which may include female heterozygotes.

pmc-12872929.title: Parents-child multiple sites of microbial and metabolic signatures in autism spectrum disorder
pmc-12872929.creator: Lingping Zhu, Haiyan Zhang, Meiling Tang, Xuefeng Yang, Yongjun Chen
pmc-12872929.description: IntroductionTo investigate the horizontal transmission of oral-gut microbiota in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) families and its potential implications for ASD pathogenesis.MethodsThe research employed a paired cohort design using family cohorts (23 ASD children/17 parents vs. 18 Non-ASD children/16 parents), conducting integrated microbiome and metabolomic analyses of oral and fecal samples.

pmc-13032528.title: Association of oral frailty and its dimensions with cognitive impairment among older adults in China: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13032528.creator: Yanru Chen, Lisheng Xu, Fan Liu, Ling Zhang
pmc-13032528.description: BackgroundGrowing evidence highlights that poor oral health may increase the risk of cognitive decline. However, the association of oral frailty and its dimensions with cognitive function remains under-explored. This study aimed to evaluate the association of oral frailty and its dimensions with cognitive impairment among older adults in China.

pmc-13115634.title: Optimization of Processing Parameters and Application Performance Evaluation of a High Thermal Conductivity, Low Thermal Resistance Gel
pmc-13115634.creator: Yuwen Xu, Danni Hong, Liangjun Liu, Wenfei Wang, Minghua Jiang, Haibing Yang, Tingxin Chen, Kun Jia
pmc-13115634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Thermal interface materials (TIMs) are essential for addressing heat dissipation challenges in high-performance electronic devices. Among various TIMs, thermal conductive gels exhibit significant potential in high heat flux applications due to their excellent flexibility and superior gap-filling capability. Current research primarily concentrates on the fabrication and performance characterization of novel thermal conductive gels, while comparatively little attention has been devoted to the optimization of processing parameters.

pmc-13439059.title: The Compilation of Ocean Economic Input-Output Tables of China from 2002-2020
pmc-13439059.creator: Jianyue Ji, Yue Huang, Zhihui Yang, Shaopeng Cao
pmc-13439059.description: Ocean economic input-output tables serve as a fundamental data source for analyzing internal industrial linkages within the ocean economy and its connections to the land-based economy. However, existing ocean economic input-output studies in China predominantly consist of cross-sectional tables for specific years, lacking consistent long-term time series data.
